title: Dove Core Skin Cleansing Study Live
background: We are running this study to understand which individual visual elements on the Dove Bodywash may increase, decrease, or have no effect on purchase intent. Instead of testing a few complete mockups and guessing what caused the preference, this study systematically varies specific design elements — such as bird treatment, lozenge position, wordmark size, dollop options — so we can measure the utility of each element independently. The goal is to give the brand and design teams clear evidence on which design choices matter most before finalizing the packaging direction.
orientation_text:
Welcome! Thank you for participating in this study.

You will be shown a series of packaging designs, one at a time.
Please rate each design independently based on your first impression. Do not compare designs with one another.
There are no right or wrong answers—we are interested in your personal assessment.

For each design, please answer:
“Would you buy this product?”

• 1 = Definitely would not buy
• 2 = Probably would not buy
• 3 = Might or might not buy
• 4 = Probably would buy
• 5 = Definitely would buy
